يسترجم (form X)

# يُسْتَرْجَمُ (yustarjamu) /jus.tar.d͡ʒa.mu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
# يَسْتَرْجِمَ (yastarjima) /jas.tar.d͡ʒi.ma/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْت
